# Zoom Calendar

<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

[Zoom Calendar Service](https://explore.zoom.us/en/products/zoom-m) is a fully integrated calendar that works in the Zoom client. It simplifies scheduling for meetings, offline events, and appointments.

## Key features

-   **External booking**

    Allows external contacts to schedule appointments directly on your calendar. No extra integrations required.

-   **Shared calendars**

    Creates team calendars for collaboration or general-purpose use.

-   **Resource calendars**

    Manages reservations for conference rooms, workspaces, or other resources.

-   **Delegate scheduling**

    Authorizes users to schedule Zoom Meetings on behalf of others when they have calendar access and scheduling privileges.

For setup instructions, see [Enabling Zoom Mail and Calendar](https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0058589).

## API features and API access

Zoom Calendar RESTful APIs let developers manage events, secondary calendars, and access controls. You can use these APIs to:

-   Automate scheduling and event management.
-   Build private services tailored to your organization.
-   Develop public applications for the [Zoom App Marketplace](https://marketplace.zoom.us/).

To learn how to obtain credentials and start building applications, see [OAuth 2.0 for Zoom](/docs/integrations/oauth/).
